apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: apidemo
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: api-demo-config
  namespace: apidemo
data:
  OTEL_SERVICE_NAME: api-demo
  OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER: otlp
  OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER: otlp
  OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER: otlp
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL: grpc
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: http://opentelemetry-collector.apidemo.svc.cluster.local:4317
  OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HTTP_ENDPOINT: http://opentelemetry-collector.apidemo.svc.cluster.local:4318
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api-demo
  namespace: apidemo
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api-demo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api-demo
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api-demo
          image: shivanshu1333/demoapi-amd:latest
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-demo-config
          env:
            - name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
              value: >
                -javaagent:/app/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar
                -Dotel.service.name=$(OTEL_SERVICE_NAME)
                -Dotel.traces.exporter=$(OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER)
                -Dotel.metrics.exporter=$(OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER)
                -Dotel.logs.exporter=$(OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER)
                -Dotel.exporter.otlp.protocol=$(OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL)
                -Dotel.exporter.otlp.endpoint=$(OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT)
                -Dotel.exporter.otlp.http.endpoint=$(OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HTTP_ENDPOINT)
                -Dserver.port=8080
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api-demo-service
  namespace: apidemo
spec:
  selector:
    app: api-demo
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  type: ClusterIP

#!/bin/bash

# Text colors
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
RED='\033[0;31m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Base URL
BASE_URL="http://localhost:8080/api"

# Function to simulate random errors
simulate_error() {
    local error_type=$((RANDOM % 5))
    case $error_type in
        0) # Timeout
            sleep 5
            return 1
            ;;
        1) # Rate limit
            return 429
            ;;
        2) # Server error
            return 500
            ;;
        3) # Bad request
            return 400
            ;;
        4) # Unauthorized
            return 401
            ;;
    esac
}

# Function to make a request and print only status code
make_request() {
    local endpoint=$1
    local should_simulate_error=$2
    
    if [ "$should_simulate_error" = "true" ]; then
        simulate_error
        error_code=$?
        if [ $error_code -ne 0 ]; then
            echo -e "${RED}$error_code${NC}"
            return
        fi
    fi
    
    status_code=$(curl -s -w "%{http_code}" -o /dev/null "$endpoint")
    
    if [ "$status_code" -ge 200 ] && [ "$status_code" -lt 300 ]; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}$status_code${NC}"
    else
        echo -e "${RED}$status_code${NC}"
    fi
}

# Function to test an endpoint with random error simulation
test_endpoint() {
    local endpoint=$1
    local should_simulate_error=$((RANDOM % 100 < 15))  # 15% chance of error
    
    if [ $should_simulate_error -eq 1 ]; then
        make_request "$endpoint" "true"
    else
        make_request "$endpoint" "false"
    fi
}

# Function to run all tests
run_tests() {
    # GitHub API Tests
    echo "Testing GitHub API endpoints..."
    
    # User related endpoints
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/users/shivanshuraj1333"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/users/shivanshuraj1333/repos"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/users/shivanshuraj1333/followers"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/users/shivanshuraj1333/following"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/users/shivanshuraj1333/starred"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/users/shivanshuraj1333/events"
    
    # Repository related endpoints
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation/commits"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation/issues"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation/pulls"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation/contributors"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation/languages"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/repos/shivanshuraj1333/kafka-opentelemetry-instrumentation/readme"
    
    # Search related endpoints
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/search/repositories?q=opentelemetry&sort=stars&order=desc"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/search/code?q=opentelemetry+language:java"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/search/issues?q=opentelemetry+is:open"
    
    # Organization related endpoints
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/orgs/SigNoz"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/orgs/SigNoz/repos"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/github/orgs/SigNoz/members"

    # NASA API Tests
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/nasa/apod"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/nasa/apod?date=2024-04-01"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/nasa/mars/photos?sol=1000"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/nasa/neo?startDate=2024-04-01&endDate=2024-04-07"

    # Reddit API Tests
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/reddit/top/programming"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/reddit/new/programming"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/reddit/rising/programming"

    # HackerNews API Tests
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/hackernews/top"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/hackernews/new"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/hackernews/best"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/hackernews/user/torvalds"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/hackernews/item/1"

    # Giphy API Tests
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/giphy/search?q=cat&limit=10"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/giphy/trending?limit=10"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/giphy/random?tag=dog"

    # Joke API Tests
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/jokes/random"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/jokes/random?category=Programming"
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/jokes/categories"

    # Test endpoint for OpenTelemetry
    test_endpoint "${BASE_URL}/test/trace"
}

# Main loop
while true; do
    run_tests
    # Generate random delay between 10 and 180 seconds
    delay=$((RANDOM % 171 + 10))
    echo "Waiting ${delay} seconds before next run..."
    sleep $delay
done

#!/bin/bash

# Configuration
NAMESPACE="default"
DEPLOYMENTS=("details-v1" "ratings-v1" "reviews-v1" "reviews-v2" "reviews-v3" "productpage-v1")
REVIEW_DEPLOYMENTS=("reviews-v1" "reviews-v2" "reviews-v3")
LOGS_DIR="logs"
PID_FILE="$LOGS_DIR/auto-scale.pid"
LOG_FILE="$LOGS_DIR/auto-scale.log"

# Create logs directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$LOGS_DIR"

# Function to log messages
log_message() {
    local timestamp=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    echo "[$timestamp] $1" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "[$timestamp] $1"
}

# Function to generate random wait time between min and max seconds
random_wait() {
    local min=$1
    local max=$2
    local wait_time=$((RANDOM % (max - min + 1) + min))
    log_message "Waiting for $wait_time seconds..."
    sleep $wait_time
}

# Function to handle script termination
cleanup() {
    log_message "Shutting down auto-scale daemon..."
    if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
        rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    fi
    exit 0
}

# Set up signal handlers
trap cleanup SIGTERM SIGINT

# Check if already running
if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
    if ps -p $(cat "$PID_FILE") > /dev/null; then
        echo "Auto-scale daemon is already running with PID $(cat "$PID_FILE")"
        exit 1
    else
        rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    fi
fi

# Write PID file
echo $$ > "$PID_FILE"
log_message "Auto-scale daemon started with PID $$"

# Main loop
while true; do
  RANDOM_INDEX=$((RANDOM % ${#DEPLOYMENTS[@]}))
  SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT="${DEPLOYMENTS[$RANDOM_INDEX]}"

  if [[ "$SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT" == reviews-* ]]; then
    log_message "Scaling down ALL reviews deployments..."
    for DEPLOY in "${REVIEW_DEPLOYMENTS[@]}"; do
      kubectl scale deployment "$DEPLOY" --replicas=0 -n "$NAMESPACE"
      log_message "Scaled down $DEPLOY"
    done

    random_wait 45 90  # Random wait between 45-90 seconds

    log_message "Scaling up ALL reviews deployments..."
    for DEPLOY in "${REVIEW_DEPLOYMENTS[@]}"; do
      kubectl scale deployment "$DEPLOY" --replicas=1 -n "$NAMESPACE"
      kubectl rollout status deployment "$DEPLOY" -n "$NAMESPACE"
      log_message "Scaled up $DEPLOY"
    done
  else
    log_message "Scaling down deployment: $SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT"
    kubectl scale deployment "$SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT" --replicas=0 -n "$NAMESPACE"
    log_message "Scaled down $SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT"

    random_wait 45 90  # Random wait between 45-90 seconds

    log_message "Scaling up deployment: $SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT"
    kubectl scale deployment "$SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT" --replicas=1 -n "$NAMESPACE"
    kubectl rollout status deployment "$SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT" -n "$NAMESPACE"
    log_message "Scaled up $SELECTED_DEPLOYMENT"
  fi

  log_message "Cycle complete."
  random_wait 20 60  # Random wait between 20-60 seconds before next cycle
  log_message "--------------------------------------"
done

apiVersion: v1
data:
  otel-collector-config: |
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
          http:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
    processors:
      attributes/rename:
        actions:
          - key: net.peer.name
            from_attribute: peer.address
            action: upsert
          - key: net.peer.name
            from_attribute: server.address
            action: upsert
          - key: http.url
            from_attribute: url.full
            action: upsert
    exporters:
      debug:
        verbosity: detailed
      otlp/staging:
        endpoint: "ingest.us.staging.signoz.cloud:443"
        headers:
          signoz-ingestion-key: ${SIGNOZ_INGESTION_KEY_STAGING}
      otlp/demo:
        endpoint: "ingest.in.signoz.cloud:443"
        headers:
          signoz-ingestion-key: ${SIGNOZ_INGESTION_KEY_DEMO}
    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [attributes/rename]
          exporters: [otlp/staging,otlp/demo,debug]
        metrics:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [attributes/rename]
          exporters: [otlp/staging,otlp/demo]
        logs:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [attributes/rename]
          exporters: [otlp/staging,otlp/demo]

    app: opentelemetry
    component: otel-collector

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: opentelemetry
      component: otel-collector
  minReadySeconds: 5
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 120
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: opentelemetry
        component: otel-collector

      containers:
        - command:
            - "/otelcol"
            - "--config=/conf/otel-collector-config.yaml"
          image: otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest
          name: otel-collector
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "1"
              memory: 2Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 400Mi
          ports:
            - containerPort: 55679
            - containerPort: 4317
            - containerPort: 14250
            - containerPort: 14268
            - containerPort: 9411
            - containerPort: 8888
          env:
            - name: MY_POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  apiVersion: v1
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
            - name: GOMEMLIMIT
              value: 1600MiB
          volumeMounts:
            - name: otel-collector-config-vol
              mountPath: /conf
      volumes:
        - configMap:
            name: otel-collector-conf
            items:
              - key: otel-collector-config
                path: otel-collector-config.yaml
          name: otel-collector-config-vol

apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: productpage-tester
  namespace: default  # or bookinfo, depending on where your Bookinfo app is deployed
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: productpage-tester
        image: curlimages/curl:latest
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          #!/bin/sh
          echo "Starting productpage tester job..."
          while true; do
            for i in $(seq 1 10); do
              echo "Making request $i to productpage..."
              response=$(curl -sS productpage:9080/productpage)
              status=$?
              
              if [ $status -eq 0 ]; then
                title=$(echo "$response" | grep -o "<title>.*</title>")
                echo "Request $i successful: $title"
              else
                echo "Request $i failed with status: $status"
              fi
            done
            
            # Generate random delay between 10 and 180 seconds
            DELAY=$(( RANDOM % 61 + 10 ))
            echo "Sleeping for $DELAY seconds..."
            sleep "$DELAY"
          done
      restartPolicy: Never
